_comment: Cards that exist only for the cast-lock test (tests/unit/statics/test_cant_cast_spells_from_zones.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_hand_only_decree` is Avatar's Wrath's second line on a free sorcery, so the lock can be installed without spending the mana the blocked lines are then measured against. `t_ember_recall` is an instant with flashback, so one card id is a HAND cast and a GRAVEYARD cast at once -- which is exactly the line the bare `cant_cast_spells` static could not draw. `t_ashen_warden` is a commander-shaped creature, the third zone. `t_total_silence_decree` writes the same lock with no `except_zones`, which is what the total prohibition looks like when it is written on purpose.

cards.name: Test Hand Only Decree
cards.oracle_text: Until your next turn, your opponents can't cast spells from anywhere other than their hands.

cards.name: Test Total Silence Decree
cards.oracle_text: Until your next turn, your opponents can't cast spells from their graveyards.

cards.name: Test Ember Recall
cards.oracle_text:
